description: Takes a handle, the first path segment of a booking link (https://host/acme/demo → "acme"), or the link itself. Returns the person or team and their bookable event types, with duration, price, and hosts with their time zones (`hostTimezones`, so you can say what time a slot is for them). A handle from before a rename also works. Next: call get_available_slots with one of the event type slugs.

handle.description: a handle, the first part of a booking link ("acme" in meettempi.com/acme/demo), or the whole link

name: get_public_profile
title: List a person's or team's event types
